steps.title: A safe king
steps.body: A king in the middle is easy to attack once lines open. Castling tucks it away and brings a rook into play in one move.
White can castle here: the squares between king and rook are empty and nothing attacks them.

options: If your king has moved, or you would pass through check
If you have a knight developed
steps.why: Castling needs an unmoved king and safe squares.
A king that waits can be attacked before it hides.

solution: It protects the king and connects the rooks.
cards.why: A king in the middle is easy to attack.
